default.description: Core window/event permissions shared by every SayIt window. Plugin permissions the frontend actually uses live in main.json (main window only).

macos-main-window.description: macOS only: dragging the main window by its custom title bar (data-tauri-drag-region calls startDragging; Windows uses -webkit-app-region and never needs this), and matching the window appearance to the app theme so native menus (select popups, context menus) use the right light/dark look.

main-window-plugins.description: Plugin permissions used by the main window's frontend: file pickers (dialog) and opening links in the browser (shell open). fs / clipboard-manager / global-shortcut / autostart are only used from Rust and need no frontend permission.
